##### Project general facts

Oasis Two is a unique residential project that truly feels like a place you can call home. The development offers modern, well-lit duplex apartments with a contemporary exterior look and thoughtfully designed interiors that reflect forward-thinking, sustainable living. Residents can choose from a generous mix of one-bedroom, two-bedroom and three-bedroom apartments, each crafted to deliver a perfect blend of comfort, style and everyday functionality.

Life at Oasis Two is enriched by an impressive collection of amenities designed to inspire relaxation and connection. Residents can unwind at the beautifully landscaped gardens, take a dip in the sparkling swimming pool, or enjoy quality time with family at the dedicated play ground and comfortable seating areas. With covered parking and seven large lifts, every detail has been considered to make daily living smooth, convenient and genuinely enjoyable.

The interiors at Oasis Two are finished to an exceptional standard, combining elegance with everyday practicality. Kitchens come complete with stylish cabinets, countertops, a refrigerator, washing machine and cooker, while bathrooms are fully tiled and fitted with vanity units, mirrors and a shower or bathtub for ultimate comfort. Double-glazed windows, central air conditioning, marble and ceramic floor tiling, and high-speed fibre optic connectivity come together to create a refined and truly modern living experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Masdar City, Abu Dhabi, isn't just a development; it's a thriving and dynamic community that embodies the principles of sustainability, innovation, and collaboration. This visionary urban hub redefines the concept of community living by seamlessly blending modernity with environmental consciousness. 

At the heart of Masdar City's community spirit is a commitment to fostering human connections while minimizing its ecological impact. Designed with walkability in mind, the city's pedestrian-friendly pathways encourage interaction among residents and visitors alike. The open public spaces, shaded walkways, and tranquil plazas provide a canvas for social gatherings, cultural events, and shared experiences, creating a vibrant sense of togetherness.

What truly sets Masdar City apart as a community is its focus on collaboration and innovation. The presence of the Masdar Institute, research institutions, and cutting-edge technology companies fosters an environment of continuous learning and advancement. Residents have the opportunity to engage with experts and thought leaders, making Masdar City a hub for knowledge exchange and collaboration that extends beyond its physical boundaries.
